# QHEGenericCorrelation

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/QHEGenericCorrelation`

```text
QHEGenericCorrelation, version 0.01

Usage: QHEGenericCorrelation [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -l, --lzmax : twice the maximum momentum for a single particle (default value = 12)
    -e, --expansion-file : file containing expansion coefficients
    -i, --interaction-name : name of the interaction (used for output file name)
    -a, --add-filename : add a string with additional informations to the output file name(just before the .dat extension)
    -n, --nbr-points : number of point to evaluate (default value = 200)
    -r, --radians : set units to radians instead of magnetic lengths

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
